method: Printed contents pp. [vi-ix] (pdf 6-9) plus per-chapter contents on each chapter opener. Athena Scientific, A Course in Reinforcement Learning, 2nd ed. (c) 2026, 'latest editorial changes 4/27/2026'. Three long chapters (161, 186 and 114 pdf pages); every chapter opener and every numbered section heading (x.y, incl. the closing 'Notes, Sources, and Exercises' sections) verified in the text cache; offset printed+20 throughout. Subsections (x.y.z) omitted; several sections are themselves long (1.6 = 52 pp, 2.3 = 44 pp, 1.8 = 23 pp of notes/exercises), so the planner may need even splits inside them. Body pdf 21-482 (printed 1-462); References pdf 483-520; no index; pdf 521-523 are publisher ads for other Bertsekas books. The 4 toc_check warnings (1.4, 1.5, 2.6, 2.8) are headings low on their page (lines 37-43), verified by grep - harmless.
